analysis.title: The AI trade is cracking: semiconductors hit make or break levels
key_insights: SOX is back at the lower end of its trading range and is testing the 200-day moving average, which the note calls a critical technical support zone.
If SOX holds the 200-day, the range stays intact. A break below risks another leg lower in semiconductors and could turn the range into a deeper AI unwind.
Semiconductor volatility was subdued throughout September but has risen sharply over the past few weeks, with VXSMH surging again on the day of the note.
SOXL is at its lowest level since mid-April while SOX has held up considerably better. The note attributes the gap to daily resets, volatility drag and differing benchmarks.
In choppy markets, leveraged ETFs can lose value even when the underlying semiconductor index holds up.
Taiwan is described as the last man standing in the AI trade and is now showing weakness, following an earlier bearish note on Taiwan.
